title: Citadel registrations export
description: The input behind ROLLCALL_CITADEL_EXPORT, in Citadel's own words: each registered application's GitLab repository and the base image of its active deployment, plus the base-image upgrades Citadel has scheduled. Rollcall never calls Citadel; a person or a job saves this file. A read-only endpoint that returns the same JSON fits as is: save its answer to the file. Extra fields are ignored.

repository.description: The GitLab group/project path the application deploys from

base_image.description: The base image of the active deployment, such as citadel/php-apache:8.4r5

due_date.description: The day Citadel forces the upgrade
